title: Spectral Decomposition of Normal and Hermitian Operators
abstract: We establish spectral theorems for Hermitian matrices and unitary diagonalizability.

sections.heading: 1. Vector Spaces and Operators
sections.text:
Definition 1.2. An n x n matrix A is Hermitian if A^* = A.
Remark 2. Hermitian matrices have real eigenvalues.

sections.heading: 2. Spectral Theorems
sections.text:
Lemma 2.2. Eigenvectors corresponding to distinct eigenvalues of a Hermitian matrix are orthogonal.
Theorem 4.1. Theorem 4.1 follows from Lemma 2.2. Every Hermitian matrix A is unitarily diagonalizable.
Proof of Theorem 4.1. Apply Definition 1.2 and Lemma 2.2.
